title: Reading part of the boundary breaks its swap symmetry

statements.text: Deploying a reference frame sensitive to only some bits on the boundary breaks the boundary’s permutation symmetry and creates a decoherent sector. This symmetry breaking is functional or semantic, not physical.

sources.quote: deploying a QRF sensitive to only some degrees of freedom of B (i.e. sensitive to only some bit values encoded on B) breaks the swap symmetry on B and creates a decoherent sector
